ModelManager.title: AI Models
ModelManager.desc: Manage local AI models for separation.
ModelManager.clearCacheConfirm: This will delete all processed audio results. Models will be kept. Continue?
ModelManager.aboutDesc: Models are downloaded once and run entirely in your browser using WebGPU. No audio data is ever sent to a server. Larger models provide better quality but require more download time and GPU memory.

SettingsPanel.title: Settings
SettingsPanel.clearCacheConfirm: Are you sure you want to clear all cached separation results? Models will be kept.

Onboarding.step1Content: Experience professional-grade AI audio separation right in your browser. Your files never leave your device.
Onboarding.step2Content: Drag and drop any MP3, WAV, or FLAC file. Our AI will split it into clean vocals and instrumentals using your GPU.
Onboarding.step3Content: Switch between different AI models and manage your local storage cache in the settings panel.
Onboarding.step4Content: Try our signature Karaoke mode with real-time lyrics, pitch adjustment, and voice recording.
